Public jQuery events

What events will Select2 trigger?

change
select2:close
Triggered whenever the dropdown is closed.
select2:closing
select2:open
Triggered whenever the dropdown is opened.
Triggered before the dropdown is opened. This event can be prevented.
select2:select
select2:selecting
Triggered before a result is selected. This event can be prevented.
Triggered whenever a selection is removed.
select2:unselecting

{% include options/not-written.html %} How can I attach listeners for these events? $('select').on('select2:select', function (evt) { // Do something }); {% include options/not-written.html %}

What events does Select2 listen for?

<select> that it is attached to. If you make any external changes that need to be reflected in Select2 (such as changing the value), you should trigger this event. {% highlight js linenos %} $('select').val('US'); // Select the option with a value of 'US' $('select').trigger('change'); // Notify any JS components that the value changed {% endhighlight %}

It's common for other components to be listening to the change event, or for custom event handlers to be attached that may have side effects. Select2 does not have a custom event (like change. You can rely on jQuery's event namespacing to limit the scope to Select2 though by triggering the change.select2 event.

{% highlight js linenos %} $('select').val('US'); // Change the value or make some change to the internal state {% endhighlight %}
